## About
House of Kings Card Club is a poker room in El Paso. We opened it to give players a safe and legal place to play, for all levels of experience, with a no rake policy.
We consider ourselves EP strong and EP proud. We hold charity poker events year-round and sponsor several El Paso leagues. The part we're proudest of is our experienced team, the people we call the HOK Family.
Players have given us a 4.8 rating across 181 Google reviews. Come by, check in, and find a seat.

## Services
- Daily membership: Club access for the day. Facility fees are separate. ($10)
- Monthly membership: Club access for the month. Facility fees are separate. ($30)
- Annual membership: Club access for the year. Facility fees are separate. ($300)
- 1-2 NL Hold'em: Buy in for anywhere from $60 up to $500. ($60 min buy-in, $500 max)
- 5-5 Pot Limit Omaha: Buy in for anywhere from $200 up to $2,000. ($200 min buy-in, $2,000 max)
- Weekly tournaments: Different tournaments run each week. Check the upcoming events page for the schedule.

## FAQ
Q: Who can become a member?
A: Membership is open to anyone over 18. Bring a valid ID to sign up, and new members fill out a membership application.

Q: Are there fees besides membership?
A: Yes. On top of membership dues there is a $2 check-in fee and an hourly rate of $10 for use of the club facility.

Q: How do I see what games are running or get on the waitlist?
A: Check the Poker Atlas app to see live action at the club and add your name to the waitlist.
